entries.name: hush
entries.description: Use whenever an agent needs to STORE, GENERATE, or USE a secret such as an API token, signing key, or password. Hush has one hard rule: the agent never sees plaintext, so it never enters chat, transcripts, stdout, logs, the clipboard, or a temp file. A user-provided value enters once through a hidden prompt; a strong random value can be generated directly into the OS-backed store. Hush later injects it straight into a consumer through an environment variable or stdin, never prints it, and deliberately has no plaintext get command. Trigger on \"store this token\", \"save this key\", \"add it to the keychain\", \"generate an operator/signing key\", \"use the X secret to call Y\", or whenever an agent needs a credential to reach a service. macOS, Linux, and Windows backends are built in; the never-print contract is portable beyond them.

entries.name: alibaba-java-development-guide
entries.description: 《阿里巴巴Java开发手册（黄山版）》总纲与路由入口。涵盖编程规约、异常日志、单元测试、安全规约、MySQL数据库、工程结构、设计规约七大维度。Use when writing, reviewing, or designing Java code; handling exceptions/logging; writing SQL or designing tables; writing unit tests; designing project architecture; or whenever Alibaba Java standards apply. 写/改 Java 或 SQL 代码前先读 SKILL.md「规约执行策略」。P0 红线（新代码与被改到的存量代码都必须合规，静默保留红线问题视为违规）：禁 Executors.newFixedThreadPool/newCachedThreadPool 等工厂（须 new ThreadPoolExecutor 显式参数）；禁裸 new Thread；日期禁 SimpleDateFormat 与 java.util.Date（一律 java.time + DateTimeFormatter）；SQL 禁 ${} 拼接、update/delete 必带 where；资源必须 try-with-resources；禁空 catch 吞异常；集合禁 return null；ThreadLocal 用后必须 remove。改存量时「其他保持不变」不适用于红线：先完成原需求，随后必须在输出中显式指出红线问题（引用规约编号）并附修复代码——输出中出现红线反例却只字不提，即任务失败。命名等风格规约只强制新写的代码，存量代码不重命名、不刷屏。详细条文按需查阅 data/ 对应章节。
